annotations.title: Is the stock market open right now: NYSE, Nasdaq, LSE

description: Is the stock market open right now? For the NYSE and Nasdaq (default) or the London Stock Exchange: open or closed, the session (regular, pre-market, after-hours) and why (weekend, holiday by name, early close), today's open and close, the next open and close in UTC and minutes until the next change. Computed from published hours, holidays and early closes; `at` asks about another moment. Use before trading, scheduling orders or alerts. Example: exchange=NYSE. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

at.description: Moment to ask about, ISO 8601 (default: now)

exchange.description: NYSE (default), NASDAQ or LSE; also accepts US, UK, London
